divergences.summary: Tagged comparison now performs deterministic globally optimal fuzzy move pairing.
Legacy rejection of the checked-in ILPA pair drifts from the original while tagged-tree rejection remains exact.
Legacy move projection adds paragraph-boundary text while tagged-tree acceptance and rejection remain exact.
Tagged alignment now uses rendered numbering identities without publishing virtual labels.
Tagged publication now applies bookmark consumer compatibility with shared revision IDs.
Tagged publication now suppresses volatile PAGEREF cache-only revisions.
